a1
In a vision, the Lord said to Abram: do not be afraid. I am your shield.
b1
Abram said: I have no child. My heir is a servant of my house.
b2
The Lord answered: your own son will be your heir.
c1
He took Abram outside: count the stars, if you can. So shall your descendants be.
c3
Abram believed the Lord, and the Lord counted it to him as righteousness.
d1
Abram asked: how will I know that I will possess this land?
d2
The Lord told him to bring animals, and Abram cut them in two.
d3
At sunset a deep sleep fell on Abram, and a great darkness came over him.
e1
His descendants would be strangers for four hundred years, then come out with great wealth.
e2
In the dark, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch passed between the pieces.
e3
That day, the Lord made a covenant with Abram.
h1
Abram could not see how the promise would happen.
h2
Yet God said: look up. Count the stars, if you can.
h3
Abram believed, and God counted his trust as righteousness.
h4
When your future looks dark, look up. Trust the One who made the stars.
i
Where do you need to trust God in the dark?
